name: io.github.RegistrumUK/uk-companies-house-mcp
title: UK Companies House (Registrum) - no API key
description: UK company data: profiles, iXBRL financials, directors, PSC chains, ECCTA. Hosted, no key.

environmentVariables.name: REGISTRUM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Without it the server uses the keyless hosted endpoint https://registrum.co.uk/api/mcp, which has daily caps. A free key gives 60 days of full access (every endpoint, no monthly cap, no card), then stays free for light use. Get a free key at https://registrum.co.uk/?utm_source=mcp&utm_campaign=registry
